text: The Infrastructure for Safer and Resilient Schools (ISRS) Project is a Philippine government initiative, financed by a World Bank loan, aimed at restoring and strengthening public-school infrastructure damaged by disasters. It focuses on building resilience into school facilities and their operation and maintenance systems to reduce future learning disruptions. The project targets schools affected by earthquakes and tropical cyclones from 2019–2023, prioritizing regions with the greatest infrastructure damage and risk.
